content.title: The Bold & The Beautiful's Kimberlin Brown Speaks Out After Surprise Exit From Show - IMDb
content.text: The Bold & The Beautiful's Kimberlin Brown Speaks Out After Surprise Exit From ShowKimberlin Brown is opening up about her exit from The Bold and The Beautiful!The 62-year-old actress starred as Sheila Carter on The Young and the Restless, before bringing the character to Bold, where she has starred off and on for the past 32 years.However, fans were recently shocked when Sheila died on the Monday, February 26th episode, after being stabbed to death.Kimberlin is now speaking out about her exit from the show and the character.Keep reading to find out more…“Well, you know, it’s a tough place for me to be in right now; I’m not going to lie about this,” Kimberlin told TV Insider. “I guess if anyone were going to take Sheila down, I’m happy it’s Steffy.
